description: Mobiliserade byar: hur lokalsamhällen agerade under skogsbränderna 2018 och omorienterar sig mot framtiden is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Umeå universitet. In the summer of 2018, wildfires erupted in Swedish forests at a magnitude without precedence in modern Swedish history. Coverage: Umeå universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Mobilized villages: local community agency during the Swedish wildfires in 2018 and the process of re-orientation toward" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Umeå universitet. Its keywords include disaster, ETNOGRAFI, lokal mobilisering, social sustainability, social hållbarhet, ETHNOGRAPHY. The listing shows 2024-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
